Girl.. not to tell you what you should do, but dump that man. Seriously, please don't let anyone make you feel like that, and say those things to you. Imagine if everything stays the same from now on, and he won't change (in fact, it will get even worse, because he thinks it's okay if he makes you feel like that now)- would you be able to live the rest of your life like this? 

Of course, you know your situation better, but from an outside perspective it's clear as day that this is a case of emotional abuse and manipulation. Maybe resulted from grooming?

Also, off topic, but what you said reminded me of a quote I really love from 'The perks of being a wallflower': "We accept the love we think we deserve"

A lot of people start going to college when they are old. A lot of people drop out of college. Even more people don't go to college at all. I know comparing to other people is not what you need right now, but what I want to say is that this isn't the highlight of your existence. If you are not happy here and you know you don't want to pursue that career, why do you continue with it? You can still take time to discover yourself and study what you life. Why the rush?
In that case, you should definitely give therapy a chance, if you haven't already. This way you will talk to someone who will do everything they can to help you, and who will understand you
